pre_registration.criteria_fixed: before the R4 docking, from ADR-AIIM-132 and ADR-AIIM-150

protocol: 8 conformers, exhaustiveness 32, 10 poses — the protocol the 500 selected compounds received. The fast-pass figures are ADR-AIIM-150's and are not superseded; they answer a different question.

protocol_shift.why: Part of the rise from the fast-pass rate is the protocol finding better minima, not the compounds being better. This separates them.
protocol_shift.reading: The fast pass under-scored the compounds it rejected three times as much as the ones it kept.

no_full_protocol_enrichment: The 4,999 compounds the funnel kept were never docked at the full protocol, so no matching denominator exists and no full-protocol enrichment factor is computed. The released 1.43 is a fast-pass figure and is not restated.
